tool_calls.name: submit_proposal
tool_calls.arguments: {"summary":"Putting some extra on the card and the rest into the emergency fund keeps the household’s cash buffer while still shortening the card payoff, and it respects the household’s preference for flexibility. Pushing all the surplus to the card pays it off sooner and cuts the card’s interest more, but it stops emergency-fund progress. {"reply":"Mara’s new job gives you more room each month. You now have ₱25,050.00 of monthly surplus, with ₱16,000.00 still unallocated, so both choices you asked about fit.

- The split keeps building your cash buffer and gets the emergency fund to target in 4 months, while the card is paid off in 7 months.
